about_the_game:
[Hunter Roulette] – Multiplayer Strategy & Deadly Bets in a Cyberpunk Wasteland

Post-Apocalyptic Cyberpunk: A Feast for the Eyes, a Jolt to the Heart

After the cataclysm, the irradiated surface lies silent. Survivors cling to life beneath, packed into a steel-forged city where scarcity rules and profit is the only truth. For the cyber-modified masses, electricity and neon are the new sun, and guns and chips their gospel. Welcome to Hunter Roulette—a brutal game where every shot could be your last.

Hunter Roulette reimagines cyberpunk through the lens of ruin: Colossal machine husks hang broken overhead, data pulses like veins across steel walls, and holographic dealers shout countdowns at betting tables. Each shot tears the air, setting off a dazzling chain of destruction. This is wasteland art—a visual symphony of brutal precision.

Core Gameplay: Life-or-Death Mind Games

[Basic Rules: Odds, Guts, and Wits]

Built on Classic Russian Roulette—Only Crazier:

Bullet Gamble: Guns are randomly loaded with live rounds and blanks. Shoot yourself or your opponent. If you survive a self-shot with a blank, you shoot again.

Mechanic Innovation: Frenzy Points make offense your best defense. Attack to earn Frenzy Points and strike back even with 0 HP!

Deadly Arena: Bet your life—use dozens of props to outsmart, overwhelm, and eliminate.

Free-for-All Mayhem: Everyone’s your enemy. Take out the weak or keep the balance—it's your call.

「Wicked Props: Your Cheat Codes to Twist Fate」

Over 20 game-changing props turn this luck-fest into a battlefield of strategy:

"Maintenance Kit": +1 damage this turn.

"Burst Mode": Shoot twice this turn.

"Spare Magazine": Force a player to reload. Chain props for explosive combos—buff with "Maintenance Kit", then unload with "Burst Mode" to flip the match in a flash!

Multiplayer Frenzy: Social, Strategic & the Climb to Glory

「Three-Player Mayhem: Night of Betrayal」

Breaking new ground with a 3-player brawl—a chaotic free-for-all battlefield:

Cooperation and Betrayal: Ally with the weak to take down the strong—but watch your back.

"Bounty Mark": Tag a threat. Cash in on the kill.

「Deep Lore: Legends of the Wasteland」

Delve into the shadows of the underground city and uncover three faction storylines:

"Wolf Mafia": Money makes might—crush your foes with an unstoppable income engine.

"The Unclean": They live by the code of desperadoes—weakest, yet deadliest when cornered.

"New Theism": Masters of turning nothing into everything—your salvation when you’ve lost it all.

「Global Rankings: Kings of the Wasteland」

The seasonal global race is on—climb the ranks and seize glory:

"Ranked Challenge": Climb to the top with win streaks and unlock massive rewards.

"Survival King": The longest win streak takes the throne.

"Character Master": Dominate with your main to earn massive rewards.

Characters & Firearms: Where Personality Meets Violent Aesthetics

「8 Maniac Heroes」

"Bioweapon No.13" – Ultimate: "Private Vodka" – Turns his Frenzy Points into HP.

"Pirate Octopus – Annie" – Ultimate: "Bullet Swap" – Turns someone's blank into a live round.

Each character features exclusive skins, hidden lore, and a solo story mode to uncover their past.

「Feel Every Shot: From Kickback to Killshots」

Powered by dynamic, physics-based feedback:

Recoil Simulation: Shotgun blasts send your screen shaking.

Adaptive Vibration: Feel the difference between blank thuds and live round cracks.

A Diverse Arsenal: Pick from skill-powered guns like the RedSiren (rapid fire) and Carnivore (cash on hit).

Social Mayhem: Break the Rules, Stream the Chaos

「Bestie Mode: Ride-or-Die」

2-Player Teams: Partner up for a 2v2 survival brawl—when your buddy’s bleeding out, patch them up with a transfusion and keep the fight going.

"Custom Room": Challenge your friends anytime with a private match.

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: General Mature Content

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 - 4460, 3.20GHz or above AMD FX - 6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 or AMD Radeon R7 260x (with VRAM of more than 2GB)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: It must be 64 - BIT
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 3770 3.4GHz or Intel Core i3 8350 4GHz or AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060（VRAM 3GB) or AMD Radeon™ RX 570 (VRAM 4GB)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: It must be 64 - BIT

short_description: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the underground survivor's showdown! All you need is a locked-and-loaded gun and the guts to stare death in the face to have the time of your life. Ready or not, this isn’t just any gamble—it’s your one shot at survival and rebirth. The hunt starts now！Good luck!
